# PromptStarters

A few things a person could ask PLUS AI, as a wrapping row of prompt `Suggestion` chips. - **starters** are `{ id, label, text }`: the short `label` on the chip and the longer `text` it stands for. - **onSelect(starter)** runs when a chip is pressed, with the whole starter and nothing else. A starter suggests; it never sends on its own, so the caller decides what happens — usually putting `text` in a `PromptInput` for a person to read and send. - **label** names the group for assistive technology.

**Import:** `import { PromptStarters } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/labels/PromptStarters/PromptStarters.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/labels/PromptStarters/PromptStarters.stories.jsx` — Default, SelectHandsBackTheStarter, EmptyRendersNothing, FillsThePromptInput

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `starters` | arrayOf or shape or string or number | `[]` | What to offer: `id` for the key, `label` on the chip, `text` for the prompt it stands for. |
| `onSelect` | func | — | Called with the starter that was pressed. It never sends anything itself. |
| `label` | string (required) | — | The group's accessible name, such as "Suggested prompts". |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
